data.name: Bsea Cancun Plaza Hotel
data.address: km 20.5, Blvd. Kukulcan, Zona Hotelera, 77500 Cancún, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
Overlooking the Caribbean Sea, this straightforward beachfront hotel is 3 km from Museo Maya de Cancún and 6 km from Dolphinaris Cancun.
Airy, unfussy rooms feature balconies and kitchenettes. Suites add living rooms, and some have dining tables and 2 levels. Room service is available.
Parking is free. There's an outdoor pool with a kids' section. A bright restaurant with a terrace overlooking the pool and sea serves wood-fired pizza. There's also a casual deli and a kids' club (fee).
